##### Project general facts

Imperial Avenue is an iconic 45-story landmark tower developed by Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate, a prestigious name with over 150 years of construction excellence. This exceptional development presents premium apartments with best-in-class facilities. The Imperial brand, synonymous with bespoke luxury, has redefined the benchmarks of luxury living, creating a unique architectural masterpiece that exceeds the expectations of connoisseurs of luxury living.

Residents enjoy an extraordinary array of world-class amenities designed to elevate every aspect of daily life. Two infinity pools on levels 9 and 26 offer different experiences of extravagance, while a private AV room equipped with state-of-the-art amenities makes private screenings exclusive. A best-in-class gymnasium enables residents to attain fitness goals, and a grand party hall large enough to entertain over 200 guests opens to the poolside deck on the 28th level. A clubhouse with best-in-class equipment, a squash court, indoor recreation area, and dedicated kids' play areas with indoor and outdoor pools complete the offering.

Every residence at Imperial Avenue features thoughtfully designed spaces with contemporary kitchens featuring modern cabinets and efficient storage. The living rooms are designed minimalist to provide a soothing ambience, while ensuites bathrooms with exquisite fixtures and separate glass-walled showers offer spa-like luxury. Solar panels on the roof provide centrally heated water supply, greywater treatment plants ensure sustainable water sources, and drinking water purifiers are offered in every apartment.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Downtown Dubai, the melting pot of global cultures, this exceptional location places residents at the heart of the world's most celebrated neighbourhood. With Burj Khalifa at its centre, the area is the destination for shopping, entertainment, dining, and hospitality at world-class hotels, featuring Dubai Opera, Dubai Fountains, and a host of performances by global artists.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning and world-class infrastructure. The area is home to some of the largest malls in the world, a nucleus of business and trade with DIFC and Business Bay, best-in-class medical facilities, and high-quality education with a choice of curriculum. The vibrant nightlife and diverse culinary experiences attract connoisseurs from across the globe.

For those seeking a residence that embodies timeless elegance, grandeur, and a prime Dubai address, Downtown Dubai delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of iconic landmarks, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the world's most desirable destinations. This is a place where only the exceptional can reside.
